asn.description: 1 to 10 digits, without AS prefix. Requires asn capability.

city.description: Letters, digits and underscores; normalized to lowercase. Requires city capability.

count.description: Number of connection strings. Omission, null and legacy zero values use one.

country.description: Two-letter country code; normalized to lowercase. Requires country capability.

job_id.description: Owned active job beneath project_id. Only its validated opaque token is included in generated proxy usernames.

lifetime.description: Sticky session lifetime in seconds, 60 to 86400, or 1 to 86400 when the service has session_lifetime_seconds. Maximum is 1800 with session_lifetime_30m. Requires session=sticky and session_lifetime capability. Residential IPv4 Unlimited requires whole minutes. Omitted or zero leaves the lifetime unset.

project_id.description: Owned, active project access. Omit to use main access. Requires current project support.

region.description: Requires region capability. Services with region_code accept only an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code of 1 to 3 letters or digits without country prefix (for example CA). Other services accept letters, digits and underscores up to 32 characters. Normalized to lowercase in customer usernames.

template.description: Required only for format=custom. A single line of literal text, limited to 512 UTF-8 bytes, with at least one of {HOST}, {PORT}, {USER}, {PASS} or {PROTOCOL}. Other braces and control characters are rejected. Placeholder values are substituted literally without escaping or recursive expansion. {PROTOCOL} is the connection URL scheme (http, https or socks5h).
